description: Build an UNSIGNED tx that approves `spender` to move up to `amount` of `token` on behalf of the wallet that signs it — e.g. the NonfungiblePositionManager before build_mint/build_increase, or Permit2 before a Permit2-paid build_swap. Pass amount="max" for an unlimited (uint256 max) allowance. Returns the tx plus unsigned rlp; when simulated, simulationResult={approved} decoded from the eth_call return data. Pass `sender` (the signing wallet) to eth_call-simulate before signing.
name: build_approve
title: Build an ERC-20 approve transaction
